QuestInfo.name: Mission: Rescue Gabrielle
QuestInfo.0: #p2450001# asked the duo for help, and first stop would be talking to #b#p2450002##k in #b#m325000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2450002# sent them to the lower level of town, through the #bsewers#k between the police station and the kindergarten. What would they find?
QuestInfo.2: #p2450001#, #p2450002#, and #p2450004# were waiting below in an abandoned storehouse. They were planning to rescue #p2450003#.

0.0: Sorry about the double-cross, but Belle and I had to make sure you two were okay. We don't make it a habit of trusting strangers right off the bat...
0.1: I'm still not totally sold on your loyalties, but I guess Belle and the cat aren't the worst judges of character. I'll tell you how to get into the hideout.

yes.0: You'll see the #bpolice station and kindergarten#k on the west side of town. There's a pipe between the two. Go inside, and try not to let anybody see you.

1.0: You made it. This is an old Rue Ore storehouse. I've gathered the others here... to #brescue Gabrielle#k.
1.1: Gabrielle's been missing for days now, but the council hasn't done a thing and we don't have any idea what the kidnapper's demands are. It's ridiculous. That girl's life is at stake!
1.2: We can't wait for them to make a decision. The poor girl could starve to death.
1.3: We've been a couple of hands short for our plans to go through... until you two came along. It works out for you, since you're trying to get in touch with the kidnapper, yeah?

yes.0: None of us care why you want to see the kidnapper. We just want to see Gabrielle safe again. I hope you'll help us make that happen.

npc.0: You'll see the #bpolice station and kindergarten#k on the west side of town. There's a pipe between the two. Go inside, and try not to let anybody see you.
